<!-- Generated by sync-kit from factory-kit 0.6.0. Edit plugins/factory-kit in solo-factory, not this copy. -->

Draft the MR/PR description for the current branch. Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`

1. Resolve the base: `--base` argument, else the MR target in `CLAUDE.md`, else `origin`'s default
   branch. Check `git log --oneline origin/<base>..HEAD` isn't empty; if there are no commits yet,
   say so and suggest `/factory-commit` first.
2. Collect what the agent can't see: the verify report, if `/factory-verify` saved one at the
   path `node ".claude/factory-kit/scripts/report-path.mjs" verify` prints (areas marked `not verified` must stay
   marked that way in "How tested"); test and check results from earlier in this session (exact
   commands and pass/fail), the ticket link or context from the arguments, and UI changes that
   need screenshots.
3. Launch the `factory-pr-describer` agent with the Agent tool. Give it the base ref, everything
   from step 2, and the spec path (`docs/specs/<N>.md`) when the branch belongs to an issue. Tell
   it plainly which checks were *not* run.
4. Read the draft against the diff once. Remove any claim the diff or the session doesn't support.
   Check that it ends with "How to review", and that its line ranges exist.
5. Save it to the path printed by `node ".claude/factory-kit/scripts/report-path.mjs" pr` (run it
   in the repo; don't build the path yourself): the title on the first line, a blank line, then
   the body. It sits outside the working tree, because `create-pr` requires a clean one, and
   outside `.git/`, because Claude Code blocks writes there. `create-pr` reads it from that path.
6. Show the title and body to the user and say where it was saved.
